translations.web: For the Scripture says, “You shall not muzzle the ox when it treads out the grain.” And, “The laborer is worthy of his wages.”
translations.bsb: For the Scripture says, “Do not muzzle an ox while it is treading out the grain,” and, “The worker is worthy of his wages.”
translations.kjv: For the scripture saith, Thou shalt ➔ not muzzle the ox that treadeth out the corn. And, The labourer is worthy of his reward.
translations.asv: For the scripture saith, Thou shalt not muzzle the ox when he treadeth out the corn. And, The laborer is worthy of his hire.
